title: Exact extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction on a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subspace, put $\mathcal O_U=\mathcal O_X|_U$, and let $j:(U,\mathcal O_U)\hookrightarrow(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be the open inclusion. For the abelian categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the restriction functor $j^{-1}:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)$ is exact and has an exact left adjoint $j_!:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ (extension by zero); thus $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$.

proof.text: Let J be the Grothendieck topology of opens of X. Its covering precoverage J.toPrecoverage satisfies all the precoverage hypotheses: isomorphisms, composition and base change are covering, and the category of opens has pullbacks. The generated topology is J. The inclusion into J is Mathlib GrothendieckTopology.toGrothendieck_toPrecoverage_le; conversely any J-covering sieve S is generated by its own arrows, which form a covering presieve by GrothendieckTopology.arrows_mem_toPrecoverage_iff, so Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck puts S in the generated topology. These are the two inequalities of the equality.

Apply [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] to this precoverage, the structure sheaf X.sheaf of commutative rings, and U. Transport along the topology equality from the first step. The sheaf of rings obtained by forgetting commutativity is definitionally moduleRings X. The restriction is precisely SheafOfModules.overFunctor, and the left adjoint is precisely the extension-by-zero presheaf followed by module sheafification [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Thus the specialized theorem gives the two finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation assertions and the required adjunction, without any stalk comparison.
